Časne, krásný. Opravdu, čekal jsem na to, čerak, ale потом přišla další myšlenka. Jaká? Že ji od nich chce utpínat. Ublýžíte jak? Já jsem quiser, ta různá, nikde mi to neudalo.
English: Time, beautiful. Really, I was waiting for that, tomorrow, but then another thought came up. What? That he wants to trap her from them. How do you approach it? I wanted, that different, nowhere did it work for me.
